content: Grade 1: registration fee Rs. 2,000, admission fee Rs. 20,000, term fees Rs. 15,000 per term (3 terms per year).
Grade 2: registration fee Rs. 2,000, admission fee Rs. 22,000, term fees Rs. 16,000 per term (3 terms per year).
Grade 3: registration fee Rs. 2,000, admission fee Rs. 25,000, term fees Rs. 18,000 per term (3 terms per year).
The admission fee must be paid within 10 days of receiving the admission offer. The deadline for this academic year's admission fee payment is 30 November 2026.
